about_the_game:
You explore the mind of a girl whose thoughts are fractured, whose fears have taken form. Darkness creeps, hearts race, and every sound could betray you. The world itself feels alive, hostile, and unpredictable.

In Anaria, you awaken in a mysterious house with no memory of who you are or why you’re there. Piece together fragments of a haunting story through cryptic notes, environmental clues, and cinematic moments that gradually reveal the truth. Every discovery pulls you deeper into a psychological labyrinth where nothing is quite what it seems.

Gameplay Highlights:

  • Time Manipulation – Alter the flow of time in the space you occupy to find clues, navigate rooms, and progress the story.

  • Relentless Doll Pursuer – A sentient doll stalks you, reacting to your movements, noise, and interactions with objects. Walk too close or make a sound, and it will hear you.

  • Psychological Horror Storytelling – Uncover a deeply layered narrative without full exposition; the story unfolds around you, making every exploration feel personal and intense.

  • Cinematic Moments – Cutscenes and scripted events reveal key pieces of the story, immersing you in a rich and disturbing world.

  • Exploration & Mystery – Search for clues, solve environmental puzzles, and navigate a world where perception is constantly challenged.

Anaria is more than a horror game—it’s a journey into a fractured mind, a place where fear lives both around you and within you. Will you uncover the story before the darkness consumes you?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature content including blood, sudden jumpscares, dark and tense atmosphere, and an enemy that can chase and catch the player. It does not contain graphic gore, sexual content, or explicit violence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: In Anaria, explore a fractured mind as darkness creeps and every sound betrays you. Manipulate time to find clues, evade a relentless sentient doll, and uncover a psychological horror story through cryptic notes, puzzles, and cinematic moments in a disturbing, living world.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
